name: 3S Cyborg
author: Joakim
description: The Cyborg guild HUD, fed by the Guild.State / Chassis / Combat / Progress / Systems / Info GMCP packages (3Scapes only). Tabs: Status (power against its max, stored power and regen, heat with an overheating flag, adrenaline, pain editor, stims, ammo and its loaded type, SI level, guild xp against the cost of the next step, credits, rank and time in the guild), Implants (the activated systems list, two columns, sorted), Chassis (hardpoints, power grid, weapon array and machine percent, then every body slot used and free), and Combat (kills total and this login, combat rounds, online time, the strategy order and the firing patterns). 'cyb' prints the Status page into the output window for a glance without the panel. The four figures a single capture could not settle were answered by Joakim on 1 Sep and are now shown as what they are: stored_power is a RESERVE pool an implant grants alongside power/power_max, so both are displayed; si_pct is hundredths of a percent toward the next SI level (5478 = 54.78%, so 107 becomes 108 at 100%); control_used and control_avail are a used/remaining pair whose sum is the capacity, so the panel shows the ratio and spells out the headroom; and ammo is the magazine while ammo_rounds is the case that refills it, so the two are shown as separate stores and never divided into a ratio. What is still unconfirmed: whether stored_power has a ceiling, and whether power_change is a delta or a target.
